# Experiment Results — Codeforces Rating & Tag Prediction

*Generated by `experiments/src/run_experiment.py` (seed 42, git `21d2764`). Non-transformer models only.*

**Protocol:** locked 80/20 hold-out via `GroupShuffleSplit` on `cv_group`; model selection by `GroupKFold(5)` inside train; every vectorizer/scaler/embedding fit on train folds only. Leaderboards show CV mean±std over the 5 shared folds; the champion is then run once on the locked test.

## 3. Statistical significance (§6.3)

- **rating** — Friedman χ²=33.20 (p=2.43e-05); paired Wilcoxon top-2 `LightGBM` vs `Stacking` p=0.125. CD diagram: `results/figures/cd_rating.png`.
- **tags** — Friedman χ²=39.47 (p=4.03e-06); paired Wilcoxon top-2 `LogReg_bal` vs `LinearSVC` p=0.0625. CD diagram: `results/figures/cd_tags.png`.
  - ranking disagreements: precision_micro_mean tops with `RandomForest`

![CD diagram — rating](results/figures/cd_rating.png)

![CD diagram — tags](results/figures/cd_tags.png)


*(5 folds → low-power omnibus tests; read alongside the effect sizes above.)*


## 4. Imbalance, thresholds & ordinal framing (§5.4 / §4.4)

- **Per-label threshold tuning** (LogReg_bal (OvR, tfidf_word_12)): macro-F1 0.3493 → **0.3515** (lift 0.0022); micro-F1 0.4837 → 0.3964; recall_micro 0.5169 → 0.5933. On a class-balanced champion, threshold tuning and class weighting are largely substitutes (the big threshold lift only appears on unbalanced models — see the tag-strategy ablation and `Report/classification/classification_findings.md` §3); the headline stays the base champion.
- **Rare-tag floor** (≥15 train ex., 36 tags): macro-F1 base 0.3595 → tuned 0.3667 (vs all-38 base 0.3493).
- **`*special`** (meta-tag, n=389): F1 0.3871 → 0.3738.
- **Iterative-stratification sanity** (row-level, non-grouped): micro-F1 0.451, macro-F1 0.3141 — row-level split (allows duplicate leakage) — reference only; grouped split preferred.
- **Ordinal framing** (11 bands): direct classifier exact-band 0.2511 / within-one 0.4738; regression champion `LightGBM` bucketed exact-band 0.1904 / within-one 0.494.
